not_met.question: Q2
not_met.lacks: Filling in the opening, the generator learns only to write the idea in a few sentences, as template.md:8-9 says: 'as one idea seen as a whole that every part carries out, in a few sentences'. Nothing in the template asks it to say which piece of that idea each part carries out. Yet the developer that the document serves needs exactly that when starting on a part, as intent Q1 says: 'and the piece of it the part carries out'. Components holds only what each part alone decides, at template.md:48, which isn't the same thing. The example gives each part's piece in a list that has no slot in the template, at example.md:11: 'Each part carries a piece of that idea:'. So a generator that follows the template leaves out what the developer uses, and one that follows the example adds a section the template doesn't name. In Tests, the note at template.md:162-164 asks the deliverable to name each part that makes a judgment no guard can hold, but neither the section's slots nor its figure skeleton gives that a place. The example puts it in the cost of a choice, at example.md:785-788, so the generator can't tell from the template where it goes.
